_source: Placement library (4/N). Graha drishti keyed "{Planet}:{houseOffset}" — every graha aspects the 7th, with Mars adding 4/8, Jupiter 5/9 and Saturn 3/10. Payload { text }. English-authored; run `npm run kb:backfill -- --tables=aspect-meaning`.

en.text: The Sun's gaze on the 7th brings authority into partnership — steady leadership, or a tendency to dominate the agreement.
The Moon's aspect softens the 7th: emotional attunement to the partner, with moods that colour the relationship.
Mars' 4th aspect disturbs domestic peace — energy and friction at home; excellent for property matters pursued actively.
Mars on the 7th brings passion and drive to partnership, and a sharp edge to disagreements. Classically the Kuja/Manglik consideration.
Mars' 8th aspect brings sudden turns and surgical intensity — decisive in crisis, accident-prone when unchecked.
Mercury's aspect makes partnership a conversation: negotiation, contracts and intellectual rapport matter more than sentiment.
Jupiter's 5th aspect blesses intelligence, children and creative merit — one of the most protective aspects in the chart.
Jupiter on the 7th is the classical protector of marriage: an ethical, growth-oriented partner and honourable agreements.
Jupiter's 9th aspect strengthens dharma, fortune and the guru principle — belief that guides rather than constrains.
Venus on the 7th brings harmony, attraction and pleasure to partnership; comfort can be preferred over confrontation.
Saturn's 3rd aspect disciplines courage and initiative — slow, deliberate effort that outlasts faster starters.
Saturn on the 7th delays and then stabilises partnership: later commitment, tested by duty, durable once formed.
Saturn's 10th aspect grinds career upward — recognition arrives late but is rarely reversed.
Rahu's aspect brings the unconventional or foreign into partnership — magnetic, ambitious, and prone to illusion about the other.
Ketu's aspect brings detachment to partnership — spiritual depth, or a reluctance to be fully held.
